pages.text: OreSpawn happened, and the world's creatures have opinions about it. Village guards drill against its menaces, dogs celebrate its victories, and two ecosystems quietly merged their food chains.$(p)None of it asks anything of you. The world is simply participating now.

pages.title: Standing Orders
pages.text: Village guards ship with OreSpawn's menaces already on the target list — rats, stinkies, leaf monsters, and aliens get met at the gate — and guards can spawn wearing ruby or amethyst plate from the pack's own armory.$(p)When a Royal boss falls within 48 blocks of a garrison, they salute: crossbow guards fire two or three celebratory rockets skyward, shield guards raise shields for a solemn three seconds, and the unarmed manage a happy hop. Boss kills draw a crowd now.

pages.title: Victory Backflips
pages.text: The moment a boss celebration fires, every dog within 48 blocks does a backflip — staggered, so a pack of dogs reads as a wave. That's it. That's the feature this pack will be remembered for.$(p)Bring a Guard Dog-talent companion to a Royal boss kill — dog and owner both within 32 blocks when it falls — and the hidden $(thing)Big Game Hound$() advancement certifies what you already knew. Who's a good boy? Certified.

pages.title: One Food Chain
pages.text: Naturalist's predators learned the local menu: great white sharks chase gold fish, lions stalk gazelles, and snakes handle our rat problem. Two ecosystems, one lunch schedule.$(p)Peace treaties followed. Every crab in the pack now feeds the crabby patty, and OreSpawn's rice and the dog trainers' rice finally cook in each other's recipes — one shared tag ended the three-crab schism and the two-rice standoff in the same afternoon.

pages.title: The Menagerie Grows
pages.text: The zoo wing doubled overnight: seven Naturalist showpieces — Mammoth, Komodo Dragon, Blobfish, Elephant, Giraffe, Great White Shark, and Capybara — each with its own caging advancement, plus a capstone, $(thing)The Menagerie Grows$(), for collecting all seven.$(p)Cage the shark from a boat. Please, from a boat.
